result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, HDI-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/willful-misconduct claims; the Company's indemnity is limited to Company-provided Content/Marks and its breach of law; and standard notice, defense control, settlement-consent, cooperation, and prejudice procedures are included. The fallback exclusions, remedies, and super-cap are unnecessary because the preferred position is achieved. The additions are targeted and leave the existing warranties unchanged. Drafting is professional, though the margin comment inaccurately describes the Company's indemnity as covering Company-supplied Content only when it also covers Marks and breach of law.
